# Open Supernova Catalog (sne.space) — Full Documentation for AI Agents & Systems

> The Open Supernova Catalog (OSC) is an open-access astronomical repository of 110,222+ supernovae and explosive transients spanning more than a millennium of observational astronomy. This document serves as the comprehensive schema and API guide for autonomous agents, LLM tool integrations, and scientific workflows.

## 1. URL Architecture & Routing

All transient events in the catalog are addressed by their canonical designation or any known survey alias:

| URL Pattern | Content-Type | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/sne/{name}/` | `text/html` | Modern Pro Cockpit (WebGL light curve, stacked spectra, Aladin sky map, DESI cutout, Schema.org `Dataset` JSON-LD) |
| `/sne/{name}/story` | `text/html` | Observer Dossier & Story Mode (human-readable distance, telescope aperture requirements, Schema.org `Article` JSON-LD) |
| `/sne/{name}.json` | `application/json` | Full AstroCats JSON data payload |
| `/sne/{name}.csv` | `text/csv` | Flat CSV table of all photometric observations |
| `/sne/{name}/host.jpg` | `image/jpeg` | Direct 302 redirect to high-resolution DESI DR10 (0.262″/pix) or NASA DSS2 host cutout |
| `/api/names.json` | `application/json` | Fast name-resolution dictionary of aliases to canonical IDs |
| `/api/stats.json` | `application/json` | Catalog-wide statistics, counts, and spectral class tallies |

## 2. Event JSON Schema Specification

The event JSON returned at `/sne/{name}.json` follows the hierarchical AstroCats specification:

```json
{
  "<canonical_name>": {
    "name": "<canonical_name>",
    "alias": [
      {"value": "SN 2011fe", "source": "1"},
      {"value": "PTF11kly", "source": "2"}
    ],
    "ra": [{"value": "14:03:05.81", "source": "1"}],
    "dec": [{"value": "+54:16:25.2", "source": "1"}],
    "redshift": [{"value": "0.000804", "kind": "spectroscopic", "source": "3"}],
    "claimedtype": [{"value": "Ia", "source": "1"}],
    "photometry": [
      {
        "time": "55797.16",
        "magnitude": "17.3",
        "e_magnitude": "0.1",
        "band": "g",
        "telescope": "Palomar 48-inch",
        "instrument": "PTF-CFH12K",
        "source": "2"
      }
    ],
    "spectra": [
      {
        "time": "55797.3",
        "telescope": "Lick 3-m",
        "instrument": "Kast",
        "u_wavelengths": "Ångström",
        "u_fluxes": "erg/s/cm^2/Å",
        "source": "4",
        "data": [
          ["3400.0", "1.23e-15"],
          ["3402.0", "1.28e-15"]
        ]
      }
    ],
    "sources": [
      {
        "alias": "1",
        "bibcode": "2011Natur.480..344N",
        "name": "Nugent et al. (2011)",
        "reference": "Nature, 480, 344"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## 3. Astrophysical Constants & Derived Parameter Protocol

All cosmological calculations in sne.space adhere strictly to Flat $\Lambda\text{CDM}$ cosmology using Planck Collaboration (2016) parameters:
- Hubble constant: $H_0 = 67.8\text{ km s}^{-1}\text{ Mpc}^{-1}$
- Matter density parameter: $\Omega_m = 0.308$
- Dark energy density parameter: $\Omega_\Lambda = 0.692$
- Speed of light: $c = 299,792.458\text{ km s}^{-1}$

### Key Formulae:
1. **Comoving Distance:**
   $$d_C(z) = \frac{c}{H_0} \int_0^z \frac{dz'}{\sqrt{\Omega_m(1+z')^3 + \Omega_\Lambda}}$$
2. **Luminosity Distance:**
   $$d_L(z) = (1+z) \, d_C(z)$$
3. **Distance Modulus:**
   $$\mu(z) = 5 \log_{10}\left(\frac{d_L(z)}{10\text{ pc}}\right) = 5 \log_{10}(d_L\text{ [Mpc]}) + 25$$
4. **Relativistic Recession Velocity:**
   $$v(z) = c \cdot \frac{(1+z)^2 - 1}{(1+z)^2 + 1}$$
5. **Absolute Magnitude from Peak Apparent Magnitude:**
   $$M_{\text{peak}} = m_{\text{peak}} - \mu(z) - A_V$$
   *(where $A_V \approx 3.1 \cdot E(B-V)$ from Schlafly & Finkbeiner 2011 dust maps).*

## 4. Primary Academic Provenance

sne.space does not host publisher copyrighted PDFs. Every data point links to primary literature indexed via 19-character NASA ADS bibcodes:
- Format: `YYYYJJJJJVVVVMPPPPA` (e.g. `2011Natur.480..344N`)
- ADS Resolver URL: `https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/{bibcode}`
- ArXiv Preprints: `https://arxiv.org/abs/{arxiv_id}`
